name: notes-reveal-landscape
title: Notes Reveal Landscape
description: Landscape 1920x1080 version of notes-reveal: the Russian note typed in a white notes app, a centred 780x1000 column without the keyboard, cues and an exit
author: Miao Yang

variables.label: Note title line 1
variables.description: First line of the bold note title.

variables.label: Note title line 2
variables.description: Second line of the note title.

variables.label: Note body line 1
variables.description: First typed line. The seven body lines are the bulk of the video: they tell the story of the brand this video promotes.

variables.label: Note body line 4
variables.description: Fourth typed line: the turn, where the brand enters.

variables.label: Note body line 5
variables.description: Fifth typed line: name the brand here.

variables.label: Cues
variables.description: Comma-separated seconds from mount start: 1 typing starts, 2-8 body lines 1-7 finish typing, 9 the note fades out (only when exit is fade). Each stretch of the authored motion is sped up or slowed to land on its cue. Empty keeps the measured rhythm.

variables.label: Exit
variables.description: none holds the finished note to the end of the mount.
